notes: Rule 11: the report opens as Nadr's own first-person narration («صلى إلى جنبي») with a scene in which Wuhayb answers and Ibn Tawus speaks; whether the scene is a transmission needs a ruling
Best reading: the saying's chain runs through Ibn Tawus, his father (a bare relation) and Ibn Abbas, with the Prophet as end; Wuhayb's answer is only in the scene and is not a link
«- يعني السعدي -» and «- المعنى -» are editor's glosses: left out
